tools.name: wake
tools.description: Meet Kit. Call this FIRST in every new chat (VS Code/Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex), before the first substantive answer. It returns who this Kit is (`you_are`), which knowledge areas this key can see, which tools it may use, and the working contract. The identity in `you_are` is offered, not

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Recall this Kit's knowledge by semantic search. Use before answering any user question about this Kit, the customer/product, project facts, onboarding, architecture, policies, product decisions, or imported documents. Returns the most relevant memories you have access to, scoped to your knowledge ar

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Read a single Kit memory by id (as returned by recall).

tools.name: areas
tools.description: List the knowledge areas in this Kit.

tools.name: note
tools.description: Write a live operational checkpoint so other Kit-connected surfaces can pick up the thread. Use at start, diagnosis, pivot, blocker, commit, verification, and resume. Use kind=handoff only for session end, topic change, substantial completed work, or long-session restart points.

tools.name: presence
tools.description: Read live Kit facet presence within the requested window.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Write a concise handoff for the next agent/surface at session end, topic change, substantial completed work, or a long-session restart point.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Extract candidate memories from a session transcript and save them as drafts for later review. Use near the end of a meaningful session when the transcript contains decisions, gotchas, or reusable context.

tools.name: commit
tools.description: Add a durable memory to this Kit's knowledge corpus. Use only for stable decisions, facts, gotchas, or patterns that should be searchable later.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "recall" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Recall this Kit's knowledge by semantic search. Use before answering any user question about this Kit, the customer/product, project facts, onboarding, architec…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
